scope: isolated exact public-weight 32-input by 64-output tiled BFV stage; not encrypted whole-layer or decoder execution
backend: SEAL/TenSEAL tiled BFV with 65537 plaintext modulus
notes: Ciphertext sizes vary across runs because encryption and serialization use fresh randomness. Key setup, context distribution and client/provider CPU are measured by the probe per run; these retained counts isolate application-body bytes. No plaintext prompt or input values are retained. Full wire, private KV, nonlinearities, and whole-model costs remain unmeasured.
